en.headline: Hong Kong International Airport becomes first in world to receive IATA One ID…
en.dek: The Airport Authority said the certification recognises its Flight Token biometric system, which more than 80 per cent of departing passengers can use across departure checkpoints.
body: Hong Kong International Airport has become the first airport in the world to achieve One ID Certification from the International Air Transport Association, the Airport Authority announced on Wednesday.

The certification covers the three domains applicable to airports: Contactless Travel, Biometric Handling, and Privacy, Consent and Governance. IATA One ID sets global standards for the use of digital identity and biometrics so passengers can pass through key checkpoints using facial recognition rather than repeatedly presenting passports and boarding passes.

At the airport, the Flight Token self-service system uses facial recognition for the departure journey. The authority said more than 80 per cent of departing passengers are eligible to use it at all checkpoints, and more than 93 million passengers have used the system since its launch in 2021.

Airport Authority chief executive Vivian Cheung said the certification affirms the airport's commitment to enhancing the passenger experience through innovation and shows that its digital identity processes meet IATA's global standards. She said the airport will continue to advance its smart airport development.

zh.headline: 香港國際機場成為全球首個獲IATA One ID認證的機場
zh.dek: 機場管理局指，認證肯定「登機易」生物特徵系統，超過八成離境旅客可於各檢查站使用。
body: 香港國際機場星期三宣布，成為全球首個獲國際航空運輸協會（IATA）One ID認證的機場。
認證涵蓋適用於機場的三個範疇，包括非觸式旅程、生物特徵處理，以及私隱、同意及管治。IATA One ID訂立數碼身分及生物特徵技術的全球標準，讓旅客可透過容貌辨識通過主要檢查站，無需重複出示護照及登機證。
機場的「登機易」自助系統利用面部辨識精簡離境流程。管理局表示，超過八成離境旅客合資格在所有檢查站使用該系統，自2021年推出以來已有超過9300萬人次使用。
機場管理局行政總裁張李佳蕙表示，認證肯定機場以創新提升旅客體驗的承諾，並顯示其數碼身分程序達到IATA全球標準。她指機場將繼續推動智能發展。
